# Tripdhara - Premier Himalayan & Mountain Travel Platform

> Tripdhara is an enterprise travel marketplace specializing in Mountain & Himalayan travel: connecting travelers directly with verified local tour packages, cab operators, authentic mountain homestays, and trekking expeditions.

## Primary Himalayan Destinations Covered
- **Himachal Pradesh**: Manali, Shimla, Spiti Valley, Kasol, Parvati Valley, Dharamshala, McLeod Ganj, Jibhi, Bir Billing, Dalhousie.
- **Uttarakhand**: Rishikesh, Haridwar, Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, Uttarkashi, Auli, Chopta, Nainital, Mussoorie, Valley of Flowers.
- **Leh & Ladakh**: Leh City, Nubra Valley, Pangong Tso, Khardung La Pass, Zanskar Valley.
- **Jammu & Kashmir**: Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Sonamarg, Katra.
- **North-East Himalayas**: Gangtok, Pelling, Shillong, Cherrapunji, Tawang, Darjeeling.

## Core Offerings
- **Tour Packages**: Verified multi-day Himalayan journeys operated by licensed local hosts.
- **Mountain Cab Rentals**: Outstation and high-altitude taxi services with experienced hill drivers.
- **Homestays & Stays**: Verified mountain homestays and cottages with local families.
- **Treks & Adventure**: Guided high-altitude trekking, camping, and outdoor expeditions.
